scenario: A deli displays tuna salad without refrigeration. It started at 40 degrees F. After 3 hours on display, a probe thermometer reads 74 degrees F.
policy: Cold TCS food may be displayed without temperature control for a maximum of 6 hours, provided it began at 41 degrees F or below and never exceeds 70 degrees F during display. Food exceeding 70 degrees F at any point must be discarded immediately regardless of elapsed time.
question: Must the tuna salad be discarded?
